Thorn Shooter (Wild Animation bottom, level 1): HP 3 [square], Move 2 [square], Attack Poison (no damage), Range 4 [square]; no trait

Slime Spirit (Oozing Manifestation top, level 6): HP 5 [square], Move 2 [square], Attack 2 [square], Range - (melee); trait: Poison; card text: once per card (character token), when it would die, negate the damage and summon a second Slime Spirit adjacent

Void Eater (Negative Energy top, level 7): HP 6 [square], Move 3 [square], Attack 4 [square], Range - (melee); card text: kills while Dark is strong or waning shuffle a Curse into the monster modifier deck

Fey Subjugator (Imposed Will top, level 9): HP 4 [square], Move 2 [square], Attack 1 [square], Range 4 [square]; trait: Flying; card text: after attacking a normal or elite enemy, control that enemy: Attack -1
Prismatic Unicorn (Horned Nightmare top, level 9): HP 8 [square], Move 4, Attack 3 [square], Range - (melee); traits: Pierce 2, at end of turn infuse Fire, Air or Dark
mechanics: Grant abilities to your summons (summon performs the ability): Move +0 (Ethereal Gust, two summons), Move +0/Attack +0 (Mighty Bond, Bonded Might), Move 2 flat (Unending Dominance), Attack +1 with element consumes for Wound/Pierce 2/Curse (Primal Assault, two summons), Move +0 + Push 2 target all Range 1 + damage 2 (Biting Wind), Attack +1 (Unwavering Hand), Attack +0 with Fire-consume area (Intervening Apparitions), Move +1 Jump with Air consume for two summons (Void Imbuement), Teleport 3 (Living Mountain), Move +1/Attack +1 (Primal Infusion), Shield 1 + Retaliate 1 to all summons (Tear the Fabric), Attack +0 with Fire consume for two summons (Divided Mind), Attack +2 Wound Poison (Otherworldly Rage), Teleport 3 + Shield 1 with Dark consume damage 1 + Muddle adjacent (Interplanar Mastery)
Grant an ability to a healed ally: Push 1, Range 1, Immobilize on consume Air (Divided Mind top)
Control an enemy: Move 1 (Unwavering Hand bottom); Attack -1 after a Fey Subjugator attack (Imposed Will top)
Condition-only summon attacks (no damage value): Thorn Shooter (Poison), Rift Spirit (Muddle)

Summon-protection effects: negate next damage to a summon this round (Burning Passion), disadvantage + damage 1 on attackers of summons (Living Night, 2 slots), negate lethal damage to a summon + Invisible + Stun on it (Intervening Apparitions, 3 slots), Ward on attacked summons + damage 1 to the attacker (Imposed Will bottom), summons unaffected by Retaliate (Shadow Dart), Slime Spirit self-split on death (Oozing Manifestation)
Use-slot summon buffs: next three summon attacks +1 Attack, Pierce 1 (Void Imbuement); next summon action's summons gain Invisible (Unending Dominance, 1 slot)

Element-conditional persistent effects (strong or waning): Floating Jellyfish +3 Move (Air), Ember Sprite Retaliate aura (Fire), Void Eater kill-curse (Dark), Primal Infusion summon buffs (Fire/Air/Dark)
Recover lost cards: any one card (Unending Dominance top); a card with a summon action, played immediately for its summon action, summons gain Ward/Invisible/Strengthen (Otherworldly Rage bottom)
Summon-count scaling: Attack X, Range X+1, X = number of your summons (Strength in Numbers bottom); heal bonus on targets adjacent to two or more allies (Strength in Numbers top)
Summon-specific kill triggers: money token gained directly (Covetous Imp), Curse into the monster modifier deck (Void Eater)
Teleport on many bottoms (Mighty Bond, Burning Tether, Drifting Stingers, Shaping the Void, Living Mountain, Oozing Manifestation, Negative Energy, Horned Nightmare)

Elements used: Fire, Air, Dark (infuse and consume); conditions: Strengthen, Invisible, Ward, Disarm, Curse, Wound, Poison, Muddle, Stun, Immobilize; Push, Pierce, Jump, Flying; advantage/disadvantage
unclear: Corner icons: every corner box with icons has the small '!' tab (mandatory); recorded in summary as plain words without '!'

Intervening Apparitions bottom: the second condition the saved summon gains is the dark-blue star diamond, read as Stun (as on other 2e sheets); Stun on your own summon looks deliberate (a cost) but should be checked
Biting Wind / Divided Mind: the dark diamond with a figure and an up-pointing arrow read as Push (no Pull icon on this class to compare)
Horned Nightmare: the Prismatic Unicorn's trait prints only 'At end of turn, [Fire], [Air], or [Dark].' with element icons and no 'infuse' word; read as infuse one of them
Shaping the Void bottom: 'Heal 1, Target all your summons, Range 1' read literally (all your summons within Range 1)
Interplanar Mastery bottom: the consume-Dark 'all adjacent enemies' does not say adjacent to whom (the granted summon or you)
Imposed Will top: 'control that enemy: Attack -1' is read as the enemy performing an attack at its own value minus 1
Oozing Manifestation: 'character token on this card' (a once-per-card tracker) and the extra Slime Spirit's stats (same as the card's, presumably) are rules questions
Living Night bottom: two slots with no XP badges; corner persistent only, read as discarded (not lost) after the second slot
